about_short_description.short_description: Switchboard provides technology for commercial motor vehicle fleets across North America.

identifier.value: Switchboard ELD and Fleet Management Platform

product.name: Switchboard ELD and Fleet Management Platform
product.description: A platform that manages electronic logging devices (ELDs) and fleet operations to ensure hours-of-service compliance and operational oversight for commercial motor vehicle fleets.

product.name: Hours-of-Service Management
product.description: A service that tracks and manages drivers' hours-of-service to ensure compliance with regulatory limits and reset rules.

product.name: Fleet Management Reporting
product.description: A reporting service that provides detailed insights and data on fleet operations, driver performance, and compliance status.

identifier.value: IFTA and Fuel Tax Filing Automation

product.name: IFTA and Fuel Tax Filing Automation
product.description: A service that automates the calculation and filing of International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) reports and fuel tax submissions for fleets.

product.name: Weigh Station Bypass Service
product.description: A service that enables commercial vehicles to bypass weigh stations in North America based on compliance and operational data.

product.name: Proof of Delivery (POD) Scanning
product.description: A dispatch tool that accelerates delivery processing by scanning and managing proof of delivery documents digitally.
